thread:
maria: Heads up, auth-cache is spiking 503s in eu-west1, rolling hotfix ready. Need expedited approval to skip canary and push now. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: [automated] Hotfix build 20250314-hotfix-1 ready. Can run with `--skip-canary` if >=2 approvers. CI: green, small smoke tests passed.
ryan: ETA on how long rollout takes if we skip canary?
jess: What's the rollback plan if the new build regresses? Need clear criteria.
maria: Rollback criteria: error-rate > 0.5% for 5m or latency p95 +200ms. We can pin previous stable 20250313-prod-88 instantly.
matt: Can we get a quick stderr dump from the smoke run?
maria: paste: ```MEMORY OK
KV MISS RATE 0.02
auth-cache restore: success
http 200 sample 50/50
```
sre-oncall: I want a live tail for the first 5 minutes post-cutover and an owner on pager for the window. I'm oncall and will monitor.
ana: typo — my display name is ana but I'm in. +1 from infra if no schema changes. :white_check_mark:
ryan: I reviewed change log, added one line to release notes about transient cache rewarm. Link: https://go/release/20250314-hotfix-1 
jess: Approve conditional on smoke logs above and live monitoring. +1
matt: +1 for skip-canary, but require immediate rollback button if errors spike.
maria: We need one more approver (policy requires 2). @ana can you sign off?
ana: signed off. +1.
deploy-bot: [automated] Policy check passed: 2 approvers. Canary skip allowed for this hotfix. To proceed run `/deploy hotfix 20250314-hotfix-1 --skip-canary --owner=maria`
maria: running now `/deploy hotfix 20250314-hotfix-1 --skip-canary --owner=maria` :rocket:
deploy-bot: [automated] Starting rollout to eu-west1 (skip canary). Stage 1: 10% traffic. Notifying ops.
sre-oncall: watching logs now, tail attached. No errors so far. Latency stable.
ryan: tagging release notes and corr. docs, adding the rollback pin to the ticket.
jess: good. keep the runbook open: https://go/runbooks/auth-cache-hotfix
maria: Stage 1 -> 50% after 2m. still green.
deploy-bot: Stage 2: 100% traffic. Rollout complete. Duration 4m34s. :tada:
sre-oncall: confirmed zero 5xx increase, p95 down 20ms. Closing monitoring window in 10m.
maria: Thanks team. Will follow up with short postmortem and update release notes with observed metrics.
ryan: I'll file the post-deploy note and set sticky flag on the ticket for next sprint.
jess: Great job. Quick retrospective after stabilization. :thumbsup:
